name: Sierra Vista
seo_title: Sierra Vista Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 7 Events, 3 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Sierra Vista, Arizona for 2026: 7 family events, 3 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Sierra Vista turns Veterans Memorial Park into a month-long Winter Magic destination, with an ice rink, a tree lighting and a lighted parade.
celebrates: The City of Sierra Vista runs Winter Magic at Veterans Memorial Park, a month-long seasonal destination with an ice skating rink, the traditional Old World Santas display, lights and family events. The Annual Tree Lighting and Holiday Market kicks it off, with music from the Sierra Vista Community Band, children's activities, local vendors and Santa. The Sierra Vista Area Chamber of Commerce adds its Christmas Light Parade, and The Mall at Sierra Vista brings alpacas and Santa photos indoors. A New Year's Eve Party in the Park is also part of Winter Magic.
lastyear: In 2025, the city's Annual Tree Lighting and Holiday Market ran Friday, December 5, from 4 to 9 pm at Veterans Memorial Park, with the Chamber's Christmas Light Parade on the same weekend, according to Cochise County Voice. For 2026 the tree lighting is Friday, December 4, and the parade is Saturday, December 5.
facts: The hand-painted Old World Santas first appeared in Veterans Memorial Park in 2006 and became a holiday hallmark. In 2019 they were reproduced on long-lasting material thanks to community support for the city's Save the Santas campaign. Explore Cochise says 51 of the Santas now work at painting and hauling toys, baking cookies, pushing sleighs and tending to children or animals. Each year two Santas are reproduced as ornaments that visitors can take home.
trains: Sierra Vista does not have a passenger train of its own. The closest rail history stop on our site is the Benson Visitor Center Train Depot, a replica of the original depot in the Southern Pacific railroad town of Benson. Families who want a Christmas train ride can check our Tucson guide for trolley and holiday train options.
train_links: A replica of the original depot now serves as the visitor center in Benson, a Southern Pacific railroad town.

faq: When is the Sierra Vista tree lighting in 2026?

The ceremony is at 5:30 pm on Friday, December 4, 2026, at Veterans Memorial Park, 3105 E Fry Boulevard. The Holiday Market runs 4 to 9 pm that night and 11 am to 9 pm on Saturday, December 5. The City of Sierra Vista lists the event as free, with Santa on both nights.
Is there ice skating in Sierra Vista at Christmas?

Yes. The city's rink opens December 4, 2026, and is open to the public until January 3, 2027. It costs $10 per person per one-hour block, with skate rental included. Skaters can buy a wristband at the rink or reserve online, and free skater aids are available for kids.
When is the Sierra Vista Christmas parade?

The Sierra Vista Area Chamber of Commerce Christmas Light Parade is on Saturday, December 5, 2026, near Veterans Memorial Park. The city says the park entrances and exits close from 5:00 to 7:30 pm that day. The Holiday Market and children's activities continue until 9 pm after the parade ends.
Where can kids meet Santa in Sierra Vista?

Santa appears at the Tree Lighting and Holiday Market on both nights, December 4 and 5. The Mall at Sierra Vista also lists Photos with Santa on six dates between December 12 and 23, run by Buena High School DECA students. The mall does not print a photo price, so check before you go.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Sierra Vista for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from December 4 (Annual Tree Lighting and Holiday Market) through January 3, 2027 (the Winter Magic Ice Skating Rink), with the Christmas Light Parade (December 5), Photos with Santa at The Mall at Sierra Vista (December 12 to 23) and Christmas at the Empire Ranch in Sonoita (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Sierra Vista

  • 7 Christmas events for kids in Sierra Vista
  • 3 free events: the Tree Lighting and Holiday Market, the Christmas Light Parade and Story Time with the Alpacas
  • Meet Santa: the Tree Lighting and Holiday Market, and Photos with Santa at The Mall at Sierra Vista
  • Parades and tree lightings: Tree Lighting (December 4) and the Christmas Light Parade (December 5)
  • Skating: the Winter Magic Ice Skating Rink, December 4 to January 3
  • Season: December 4 to January 3, 2027
